$comment: Golden set for `yarn docs:eval`. Each case is a question a teammate would actually ask, plus the file that should answer it. Keep it small and real: 15-30 cases you genuinely care about beats 200 synthetic ones. Add a case whenever someone reports a bad search result — that is how the set stays honest about YOUR corpus rather than about retrieval in the abstract.

$baseline.note: Starting point for trend tracking. Compare the TREND across runs, not absolute values. With 20 cases the run-to-run noise is real: one query moving rank shifts recall@1 by 5 points and MRR by ~0.02, so look for a consistent direction over 3+ runs before concluding anything.
